lines.toggle.desk1.open_reveal: The drawer resists, then gives. Inside, an iron key.
lines.toggle.desk1.open: The drawer slides out along its runners, easy with long use.
lines.toggle.desk1.closed: You press the drawer home, and it seats with a soft knock of oak on oak.
lines.toggle.desk1.refused_unreachable: The desk is beyond your reach from where you stand.
lines.toggle.key1.refused_static: The key holds no working of its own; it is made for a lock, not to be one.
lines.take.key1.taken: You take the iron key. It is cold, and lighter than it looks.
lines.take.key1.refused_held: The iron key is already in your keeping.
lines.take.key1.refused_unreachable: The key is not within reach of your hand from here.
lines.take.key1.refused_contained: The drawer is shut over the key; it must be opened again first.
lines.take.desk1.refused_fixed: The desk is heavy joined oak, pegged at every corner; it will not be carried.
lines.toggle.*.refused_unknown: Nothing of that description offers itself to your hand.
lines.take.*.refused_unknown: You reach, and your hand closes on nothing of the sort.
lines.go.*.refused_unknown: No such passage is to be found; the walls keep their counsel.
lines.turn.*.refused: The room offers no other aspect; you face all there is to face.
